dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Chasey was surrendered to the care center due to his previous owners' personal circumstances. During his intake to the care center, he showed fearful behavior, including hard barking, lunging, and showing teeth at staff. His previous owner also reports that Chasey barks and lunges at unfamiliar people and dogs. They also report that he is a fast learner and very affectionate with his family and familiar people. With time to warm up and in a calmer environment, Chasey has shown social and engaged behavior with staff, offering simple behaviors on cue. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
